title: General Material Blend 3-Mix Duo #09 (가로 띠·매끈 / 세로 띠·매끈 | 인어비늘+코이비늘+공작눈무늬 / 인어비늘+이레즈미+뱀비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Korean, in her early 50s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, a cold, commanding gaze, soft pastel-pink hair styled in low bun, real pores, real living eyes, 150 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with diamonds in bronze-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of rose-gold a ring. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 29% of the way down her figure from the top and about 49% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL scale formations, VIVID SILVER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID ORANGE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL-GOLD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP VIOLET radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out, her extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Swedish, in her mid 50s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a cool, calm, faraway expression, pure icy-white hair styled in long thick box braids, real pores, real living eyes, 150 bars piercings set with sapphires in gold-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of platinum a bracelet. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 34% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 73% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID PEARL scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, fudo myo-o flames formations in ELECTRIC ORANGE and GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward, her extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
